note: Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them (as listed by Exophase and cross-checked against PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements). Every guide below is written in this guide's own words; the steps it gives are the ones its cited sources report, and where no source has verified a step yet the guide says so instead of inventing one.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Plan the run around the two golds instead: finish the story, then work the 100% Completion checklist, and this one follows on its own. No multiplayer or DLC is required.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish the first main mission of Chapter 1, Gone Fishing. Just play the story and it pops at the end of the mission.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. Chapter 1 ends once you start the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, so keep playing the story and it pops at that point.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. Chapter 2 ends once you start the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, so it pops as the story carries you into the city.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. Chapter 3 ends once you have finished the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life, so it pops early in Chapter 4.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. It pops when you finish the final main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero, which closes the chapter and moves the story on.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. It pops when you finish the game's final mission, the same mission that closes Chapter 4. Once the credits roll, the gold is yours and free-roam opens for the cleanup.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. Breakfast Run is a main mission in Chapter 2; finish it and the trophy pops at the mission's end.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. The Cartel Heist is a main mission in Chapter 3; finish it and the trophy pops at the mission's end.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. Child's Play is a main mission in Chapter 4; finish it and the trophy pops at the mission's end.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. Headliners is a main mission in Chapter 4; finish it and the trophy pops at the mission's end.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. VCIA Takedown is a main mission in Chapter 4; finish it and the trophy pops at the mission's end.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. Operation Savage Glory is a main mission in Chapter 5; finish it and the trophy pops at the mission's end.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the whole endgame. The 100% checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, but progress you make during the story already counts toward it. The requirements are forgiving — closer to 60% true completion than a real 100%: most side quests are not required, collectibles are only partly required, and you need any 70 of the 80 challenges, which lets you skip the hardest ones. The full-requirement items are the robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Practical targets PowerPyx gives: scan any 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, study any 100 of the 255 animals through the binoculars, complete 300 stunts, and finish any 100 optional missions. Nothing on the checklist is missable, and everything can be done in free-roam after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game, mixing the four kinds however you like: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 under-the-bridges flights, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps by parachute. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this trophy. Under-the-bridges runs are the quickest to farm. Track progress by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots, where each stunt keeps its own name and stays marked once done.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your counts under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities, and filter the map for Activities (the blue dumbbell icon) to find them. The story introduces most of them on its own, and working on the other trophies covers the rest, so this one usually pops without being chased.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges, spread across 12 shooting range locations. The gold thresholds are not harsh, and the ranges are also needed in full for the 100% checklist, so work through them location by location. PowerPyx keeps a dedicated page listing all 12 locations and the gold medal for each of the 42 challenges.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations — 42 drone races in total across them. You only need one win per location, not every race. The drone races are also needed in full for the 100% checklist. PowerPyx keeps a dedicated page with all 14 locations.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race location counts once, so you need 20 distinct wins, not 20 wins on the same track. There are 40 unique race locations in total, so you have twice as many to choose from as you need. PowerPyx keeps a dedicated page listing all 40 locations.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing location with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline from there and beat him in a fishing challenge to pop the trophy.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the 4 arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home using the controllers, from Chapter 1 onward (they can be temporarily unavailable during some story sections, but work again after the story). Bang For Your Buck is found on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game once — beating every challenge inside it is not required — so pick whichever you like best.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia. While playing as Lucia in Chapter 3 you get a call from Andy, then she texts her home address, which marks the questline on the map in Belville. All of her quests stay available after the story. Complete all 5: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (join the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the Cellerica van), and Puff Puff Pass (meet at the warehouse). The trophy pops at the end of the last one.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's optional questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1, a while after the main mission Island Dreams, where you work for him. He calls you, then is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. His quests are treasure diving: he marks purple treasure chest icons on the map, you dive for the treasure at 7 shipwrecks — using the metal detector to dig it from the ocean floor — and bring it back to him. After each set he calls you back and marks more. Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees, and under Progress, then Collections, then Kenton's Treasures. Kenton goes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2-3 (playing as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up), and everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. All of his quests stay available after the story. Complete all 5: Thrillbillies (check out the mud club), Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab (join Billy on a job), Mall Rats (join Billy on a job), The Impaler (steal the Impaler), and Hometown Heroes (join Billy on a job). The trophy pops at the end of the last one.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands — but only certain questlines count. PowerPyx confirms these count: Kirk (Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy?), Yago (Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother), and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile: Passing the Torch, The Last Mile: Backseat Pilot, Pete's Deliveries). Questlines for Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy. Strangers & Freaks stay available after the story in free-roam, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows how many you have done. More counting strangers are still being discovered.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's optional questline, Randy's Wish List, is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered: the Zorrusso is delivered during that story mission, and the rest are the Pegassi Vitello, Infernus, Buckingham Windsor Drop, Pegassi Toros, Tempesta, Ascot Paragon, Ocelot Jagular, Buckingham Jubilee, Grotti Itali RSX, Pfister Growler, Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire, Piccia Furia, Benefactor Dubsta, Bravado Banshee and Gallivanter Baller ST-D. Track the list under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List. He marks some cars for you in fixed locations, but you can also steal them off the street — scan a high-end sports car with the WAiNK app to see if it is on the list, then drive it back to his garage (marked by the green RK icon in the west of Vice City). Delivering in good condition pays more. It can all be done after the story, and cars turn up often in east Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels or driving around.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty, and is only available as Jason. Purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City: go to the labs and destroy them as part of the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives his second quest, Spin On This (shut down the labs), and the trophy pops when you finish it. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and you can meditate as both Lucia and Jason at each one, which counts as +2 at the same spot. Track them under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. The missable one is in Chapter 1 at Jason's house: after the main mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate and walks out to the balcony. Follow her, choose Accept, and she shows you how to meditate. That meditation raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest, and PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy — the author earned the trophy having done it, so do it to be safe. It becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1. You cannot do the final meditation until you can play both characters together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. For the 100% checklist only 15 of the 18 meditations are needed, so the checklist does not force the Chapter 1 one.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's optional questline is marked at some point after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break. While playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County — Lucia cannot receive the message, so this line is Jason-only. Do that quest and he marks hunting spots with purple icons on the map; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him as Jason. During the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nations. One clean shot leaves an animal in pristine condition and pays more, but that is not required for the questline. Track the hunts under Map, then Activities, then Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks in total, and all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist, so this trophy should come naturally along the way. PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal pops this trophy.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. Cards are a collectible type scattered across Leonida, and each set is a group of cards found in the world. PowerPyx keeps a dedicated page with all 18 set locations, so work through sets one at a time rather than hunting cards at random.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 scannable locations with the WAiNK app: hold Up, then R1, while looking at an object in the world. There are far more than 100 to choose from — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags — and any 100 count, so just scan as you travel. Scanning vehicles and animals with the same app also feeds other trophies, so make it a habit from the start.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this trophy pops automatically on the way there. View and track them under Progress, then Challenges — the Completed checkmark in the bottom right shows as you scroll over each one. Many complete naturally while working on other trophies; save this for late, then pick the easiest and quickest of the ones you have left. PowerPyx keeps a dedicated page listing all 80 challenges.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: The earliest this can be done is after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together. Call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle, then build a 4-star wanted level by causing carnage, and escape until the trophy pops — it unlocks after you drive out of the red heat wanted zone, not just out of the flashing search area. A fast sports motorcycle helps you cut through traffic, and shooting down a pursuing helicopter helps too. PowerPyx's easiest method is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: the cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. It also pops automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since the large bank vault robberies it unlocks always trigger a 4-star wanted level.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Only possible after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters and call your partner (hold Right and press Triangle). Rob 3 robbery targets in a row — the green icons on the map — while staying wanted the whole time, keeping the red-and-blue flashing wanted level rather than letting it drop or rise to the red heat level. Equip an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, and carry Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: loot a couple of items in each store and ideally break the safe in the back room with sticky bombs. The unlock is delayed about half a minute after leaving the third shop, and if it does not pop, hit a fourth shop and keep going. If you leave the first store before the police arrive, you may need that fourth store.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles using the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to open it instantly, then look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it). Scanning is enough — you do not need to drive them. The easiest method is to stand at a busy road and scan everything passing by. There are 557 vehicles at launch across cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes, and the 100% checklist wants 200 base-model vehicles scanned, so this trophy pops automatically on the way. Check your totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is activated with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots on enemies are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar in the top left, under health and stamina. You must down 5 enemies in one use, and the focus only lasts a few seconds, so prepare first: buff focus with food and drinks or by washing your face and showering at home, and consume Adrenaline (hold L1, then press Triangle) to stretch the focus time. Then line up 5 enemies — the criminals at gang operations work well — and drop them quickly without missing. Wear body armor from Ammu-Nation so you can step out of cover, and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556 for full-auto accuracy. PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting range challenges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier as you progress — and there is a good chance it pops naturally.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not a plane parked out on the airfield. The easiest is the one at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield and head straight for it, then use the stairs next to the boarding bridge, where a door leads directly into the plane (you can also walk in through the airport terminal). Inside, go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off, and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport — the unlock is slightly delayed until you are that far out.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The Rhinos stand at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance. The tanks are in the south of the air base: climb in, shoot some enemies, and the trophy pops. A video guide by PowerPyx's channel shows the exact route in.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. That unlocks the Snap Gun, for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and unlocks jewelry store robberies, which are marked automatically with a green icon in unfogged map areas. Break into a jewelry store through the back door using the Snap Gun — approaching a locked door offers kicking it (which triggers the alarm) or the Snap Gun for the stealth approach; the gadget stays in your inventory permanently and needs no equipping. Inside the back room, look for a note with the safe code and use it to loot the safe. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress and introduces bank vault robberies: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, watch a guard carry a briefcase of cash inside and open the vault, then slip in while it is open and rob it. You cannot carry all the cash alone, so bring your partner and hold Right to hand off one bag. After that quest you can pay Yasmani — the fence unlocked in Chapter 3, after doing his earlier quests, including robbing 2 Payday Loans — $10,000 for tips about security vans, which he marks with a purple icon; follow them to the bank. Each robbery instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total; this trophy needs any 5, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, so it pops automatically on the way. A single bank can pay up to $205,000, making this the best money in the endgame. PowerPyx keeps a dedicated page with all 8 bank vault locations.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe), the same mission that unlocks bank vault robberies: robbing the vault of a large bank counts as robbing an armored truck, since you tail the truck to the bank and the guard carries the cash to the vault. Escape the red heat radius afterwards, or use a Pay 'n' Spray. Since all 8 large bank jobs are needed for the 100% checklist, it pops automatically on that path. There is also an earlier method: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks — block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it up, then escape the heat radius. Sticky bombs are found in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests, and Yasmani is unlocked as a fence from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible. PowerPyx keeps a dedicated page on how to unfog the map fast, including the best plane to use.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total, and the 100% checklist needs all 39, so this trophy pops automatically on the way there. Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track them under Progress, then Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed, at the bottom right. PowerPyx keeps a dedicated page with all 39 locations.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No verified step-by-step method exists yet — PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known, and no other guide has published a confirmed route. What the official description itself says is the whole clue: enjoy a cocktail somewhere with a view on Ocean Beach, so look for a bar or venue along Ocean Beach with a seafront view and order a drink there. This guide will not invent a specific venue or button prompt until a source confirms one; check the cited PowerPyx page for updates.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You can only steal it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs (steal the Zorrusso for Randy): hack into the car, drive forward and straight through the window. The unlock is slightly delayed and pops after you drive further away on the street. It only unlocks from this specific blue Banshee, not from any other car — it is an easter egg reference to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the illegal gang operations. Before going, buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation — you need them to destroy the safe. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically in Chapter 2. Inside the bowling alley, pick up all three: the luxury watch in the office in the south-east (golden icon), the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner (golden icon), and the safe in the office in the north-east hallway, which you blow up with sticky bombs. The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing the enemies is not necessary. It is not missable: if you do not get all 3 during the optional mission, the robbery icon respawns after a long time and you can go back for the remaining valuables.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then select a character and scroll to Strength (the heart icon). You can only start after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Raise strength by working out — buy a membership at a fitness club, of which there are many across Vice City (filter the map under Activities, the dumbbell icon), or work out at home after the story. Always go together with both characters (hold Right and press Triangle to call your partner): while you actively work out with one character, the other automatically completes their training too, so you make double progress.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count out of 500. Turn on criminal profile notifications first, under Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile = On: whenever you do something that affects your reputation, a small demon face appears on the right of the screen. The profiles run from Professional (finishing objectives and robberies stealthily, destroying evidence, clean escapes), through Hardened (incapacitating enemies without killing them, such as shooting limbs), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, or driving over gravestones), to Irredeemable — a permanent status from excessive violence that makes cops more aggressive, so avoid it. It should come naturally while working on the other trophies and the 100% checklist, since every robbery and enemy encounter counts. If it is still short at the end, farm it quickly by running over civilians and cops with a car.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: No verified method exists yet — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. The official description, 'Second time's the charm,' suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt, which fits a retry at the Payday Loans store, but no source has confirmed the exact trigger. This guide will not invent one; check the cited PowerPyx page for updates as the community pins it down.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: No verified method exists yet — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from a UFO questline. The official description reads like a reaction to something strange in the world, which fits a UFO encounter, but no source has confirmed the location or trigger. This guide will not invent one; check the cited PowerPyx page for updates as the community pins it down.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No verified method exists yet — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. The official description describes a melee drive-by, which fits knocking someone over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, but no source has confirmed the exact move or target. This guide will not invent one; check the cited PowerPyx page for updates as the community pins it down.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. You need $250,000 in total, counted across all robberies, not in one go. It comes naturally while doing all the robberies for the 100% checklist, and the bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery within a few minutes, though those only unlock after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is….
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Simply spend $100,000 in total across all types of shops — the total is cumulative, so every purchase counts. The fastest way is guns, car mods and tattoos, which are the most expensive items. The shops around Leonida include 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations (gun stores), 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages, which cost $160,000 in total. They become available after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses), when you get a notification that a new app, Vice City Real Estate, has been installed on your phone — buy the garages through that app. The 4 story-related garages do not count toward this trophy. A quick way to make the money is robberies, especially in Chapters 3-4 when higher-value robberies unlock. PowerPyx keeps a dedicated page with all 12 garage locations.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location anywhere. To register 10 vehicles you first need enough garages, since each garage adds one or more parking spots — see Little Boxes. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and, in his garage, click Respray and then Register. Moses is unlocked from the same mission that installs the app. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; later, in Chapter 3, you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep expenses down.
trophies.name: On the Spot
